messages.en:
So...whatcha been up to?
Me? I've been great!

I've been eating a lot of
fruit since you left.

How did you like our fair
town? I wanna see yours!

When I feel sleepy, I think
of your face to wake up!

That smirk of yours is
kind of scary, you know.

Nothing's changed here,
and that's A-OK with me!

Hi-ho! What's new? It's
me! You know, ME!

If you're reading this, it
means you got home safe!

I guess you're happiest at
home after all?

I dance to {04 11 00}
all the time! WAHOOOO!

Dang it! It's boring here
without you! BO-RING!

You miss me tons, don't
you? I knew it!

I have something to say.
Tell {04 0f 00}, OK?

I still haven't forgotten
you! Come visit again, OK?

Hello! {0b 03 00}{04 0f 00}! Make
up your mind, will ya?

How are you? {0b 03 00}{04 17 00}
is sleepy. It's boring!
